sections.title: What actually transfers when you move
sections.body: Switching accounting systems requires a clean break. You can export your customer lists, vendor details, and item catalogues from your old system and import them here. Your chart of accounts can also be recreated to match your needs. However, historical invoices and past receipts do not transfer automatically. You must keep your old records for tax compliance. The most sensible cutover point is the start of a new financial year or a new tax quarter. You close your books in the old system, extract your opening balances, and enter them as your starting point in Paper & Pen.

sections.title: What you get when you switch
sections.body: QuickBooks is established software with a paid subscription model. Please check their website for their current pricing and plans. Small trading and services businesses often leave because they pay for complex accounting depth they do not use. By moving to Paper & Pen, you stop paying monthly fees just to issue invoices and track stock. You gain a system built for daily operations. You can add your entire sales team without worrying about per-user costs. You get core accounting, expense tracking, and document generation in a single place without a mandatory subscription.

sections.title: Who should not switch from QuickBooks
sections.body: Paper & Pen is not for everyone. If your business relies on automatic bank feeds to reconcile hundreds of daily transactions, you should stay on QuickBooks. We do not offer bank feeds or open banking connections. If your external accountant mandates a specific software ecosystem to manage your corporate taxes, follow their advice. Businesses that need a vast marketplace of third-party app integrations will also find QuickBooks suits them better. We focus on core ERP features, not external app connections. If those tools are critical to your daily operations, do not switch.

faqs.q: Can I import my old invoices into Paper & Pen?
faqs.a: No. Historical documents like past invoices, quotes, and receipts do not transfer between accounting systems. You will need to keep a read-only backup of your old data for your own records. You start fresh in Paper & Pen by entering your opening balances and creating new documents from your cutover date.

faqs.q: When is the best time to switch accounting software?
faqs.a: The most practical time to switch is at the beginning of a new financial year. If that is too far away, choose the start of a new tax quarter. This gives you a clean cutover point. You finish your reporting in the old software, extract the final balances, and use those as your starting numbers.

faqs.q: Do I have to pay for extra users?
faqs.a: No. Our core sales and invoicing features are completely free, and we do not charge per user. You can invite your entire team to create quotations, issue invoices, and manage inventory without any monthly subscription fees. You only pay if you choose to add specific modules like HR and payroll or manufacturing.

faqs.q: Will my accountant be able to use this?
faqs.a: Yes. Paper & Pen includes standard accounting features like journal entries, general ledgers, a profit and loss statement, and a balance sheet. You can give your accountant access to review your books. However, if your accountant requires automated bank imports or third-party tax integrations, they may prefer you stay on your current system.
